stores.name: Stores
stores.note: Dorrit's ledger and the trade road. Traders here turn the section's surplus into coin; haulers bring in timber, stone and iron.

levels.name: Storehouse
levels.gives: Trade and hauling bring in half as much again.

levels.name: Market yard
levels.gives: Traders from the valley come up the road: double trade.

forge.name: Forge
forge.note: Where keepsake weapons are reforged. A better forge takes a weapon further; a better smith costs less coin.

pens.name: Kith pens
pens.note: Hesk's wing. Kith kept here are fed, penned and worked each day, and grow the way they are raised.

levels.name: Rope corral
levels.gives: Two kith can stay; plain feed only.

levels.name: Pens
levels.gives: Five kith, better feed, and breeding.

levels.name: Breeding wing
levels.gives: Ten kith, every feed and pen, and the training ring.

workshop.name: Workshop
workshop.note: Crafters make what the party throws in a fight: fire pots, numbing darts and snare charges, and bandages.

levels.name: Workshop
levels.gives: Numbing darts and snare charges too, and faster.

infirmary.name: Infirmary
infirmary.note: Healers keep the wounded. With one, resting at Thornwick also eases the raw, and mends anyone left behind.

levels.name: Sick room
levels.gives: Healers make salves and teas from what they gather.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.note: A fed post works better. Cooks raise everyone's output.

levels.name: Camp fire
levels.gives: Cooks add a little to all work.

levels.name: Long hall
levels.gives: Cooks add the most, and the hall is where the post gathers.

school.name: Schoolroom
school.note: Teachers drill whoever stays at Thornwick: they gain experience each day while the party is away.

levels.name: Drill yard
levels.gives: Those at Thornwick gain a little experience each day.

watch.name: Watch
watch.note: Guards and scouts on the walls. A strong watch keeps raids off, and scouts bring back finds.

levels.name: Walls and towers
levels.gives: Thornwick can hold against a raid.
